prompt: This photorealistic photo captures a vibrant rooftop party at night. On the left, a woman in a silver dress stands holding a champagne flute, her posture relaxed as she leans against the railing. Next to her, a man in a blue suit gestures animatedly with his right hand while looking at the city skyline. In the center, a large potted olive tree anchors the scene, its leaves catching the ambient light. A waiter in a black vest is handing a tray of appetizers to a guest wearing a green hat, who reaches out eagerly to take a canapé. To the right of the tree, a brown dog sits calmly on a woven rug, watching the festivities with mild interest. Beside the dog, a child in a yellow shirt points excitedly at a floating balloon tethered nearby. Behind them, an older woman in a floral blouse sits on a wooden bench, sipping from a glass of wine. A young man in a leather jacket stands next to the bench, laughing at something the older woman said. In the background, a string of warm fairy lights stretches across the roof, illuminating the faces of the attendees. A tall speaker stack stands near the edge of the roof, pulsing slightly with the bass. There is no swimming pool visible on this urban terrace. There is no snow falling from the clear night sky.
